description:
Sources Sought for triennial inspection and testing of electrical breakers and electrical power distribution system for the Iowa City VA Healthcare System Medical Center in Iowa City Iowa.  Contract will be for services and will be firm fixed price.

To respond:
All response shall be sent by email to: Joseph.Bennett@va.gov
All email subject line shall have: 36C26326Q0532 Electrical Testing
Responses shall be received no later than:  04:30 PM CT Monday, April 13, 2026.

See attached full Sources Sought which included IMPORTANT details, Statement of Work and VA Limitations of Subcontracting Clause.
